name: prime-receipt-dashboard
description: Local web dashboard that reads hermes-prime-rlm run receipts, validates them (structure + self-hash), and renders verification evidence. TypeScript, zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && node scripts/postbuild.js
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
